hyps.name: Stop buying at 90-95c
hyps.rule: Never buy a contract priced 90c to 95c. In the bot's totals that band is the biggest leak.
hyps.verdict: The 466 bets it would skip lost $31.08 looking back. Not yet proven beyond luck. Live: 125 bets, +$12.66.
hyps.line: Tested 'Stop buying at 90-95c': 125 paper bets, +$12.66, looks good, not proven

hyps.name: Only buy 95c and up
hyps.rule: Skip every bet priced under 95c. Only the 95c-and-up pocket pays after fees.
hyps.verdict: The 1054 bets it would skip lost $59.69 looking back. Not yet proven beyond luck. Live: 283 bets, +$41.86.
hyps.line: Tested 'Only buy 95c and up': 283 paper bets, +$41.86, looks good, not proven

hyps.name: Drop XRP
hyps.rule: Stop betting on XRP. It loses while Bitcoin wins (the alt coins are noisier and move together).
hyps.verdict: The 109 bets it would skip lost $46.71 looking back. Not yet proven beyond luck. Live: 34 bets, +$9.61.
hyps.line: Tested 'Drop XRP': 34 paper bets, +$9.61, looks good, not proven

hyps.name: One bet per 15-minute window
hyps.rule: When several coins are bought in the same window, keep only the safest (highest priced) one. They move together, so they are really one bet.
hyps.verdict: The 502 bets it would skip lost $23.53 looking back. Not yet proven beyond luck. Live: 146 bets, +$20.81.
hyps.line: Tested 'One bet per 15-minute window': 146 paper bets, +$20.81, looks good, not proven

hyps.name: Skip the thin overnight hours
hyps.rule: No bets from midnight to 8 am New York time, when the order books are thin.
hyps.verdict: The 409 bets it would skip made $46.02: the rule would have cost money. Live: 113 bets, -$20.56.
hyps.line: Tested 'Skip the thin overnight hours': 113 paper bets, -$20.56, no help, it would have cost money

hyps.name: Rest orders instead of paying the fee
hyps.rule: Post a resting order one cent better instead of taking the price. The maker fee is a quarter of the taker fee, but you only get filled when the price moves against you.
hyps.verdict: Fees took about $144.45. Resting orders pay a quarter of that fee, up to $108.34 saved if every order filled, but they only fill when the price moves against you. The bot does not log bid and ask, so this cannot be proven yet.
hyps.line: Tested 'Rest orders instead of paying the fee': fees ate $144.45, up to $108.34 could be saved, needs data the bot does not log yet

hyps.name: Skip bets too close to the strike
hyps.rule: Skip the hourly Bitcoin late favourite when the price is within a few minutes of volatility of the strike. Needs free public spot candles joined to the bets.
hyps.verdict: Cannot be tested yet: it needs free public spot candles joined to the bot's bets, which the feed does not carry.
hyps.line: Tested 'Skip bets too close to the strike': needs data the bot does not log yet

hyps.name: Bet smaller
hyps.rule: Never stake more than 5% of the bankroll on one bet. Same bets, smaller size.
hyps.verdict: At 5% of the bankroll the same bets would have made -$75.29 instead of -$89.74, and the worst day would have been -$35.38 instead of -$42.17. But the bot has no edge after fees, so smaller bets only slow the bleed: the chance of losing half stays near 100%.
hyps.line: Tested 'Bet smaller': 1513 paper bets, +$14.45, worst day -$42 to -$35, it only slows the bleed
